The CLI lanes still need better completion markers than temp final-message files.

The Arby/Aster timeout is an open gap, not a failure of the whole phase.

Connector rows should stay readiness-only until a connector write packet exists.
Live-write rows remain approval-draft-only.
User skills can be sampled safely through frontmatter metadata only.

P0/P1/P2 tiers keep inspection, dry-run, and simulation boundaries separate.

The 32-search source refresh remains usable within this same continuous session.
Official architecture sources inform THOS design only.
External AI platforms do not validate GMUT physics claims.
run_id, trace_id, retry_window_seconds, timeout_reason, and payload_publication are now explicit.
The schema can be applied to app and CLI lanes together.
AI governance sources support risk vocabulary, not canon promotion.
Journey context remains non-canon unless cited in a bounded local artifact.
All six GMUT gates remain open.
v6 x2 should turn these selections into a tighter synthesis and next queue.
v6 x2 should decide whether another overlay is needed from fresh lane evidence.
Publication still requires exact staging and remote-equals-local verification.
